_comment:
'**Instant** - {t} your hero, destroy this: **Amp 1**'

ABILITY TYPE: 'Instant -' before the colon is an activated ability with instant timing, so INSTANT (maps to ON_ACTIVATE, trigger_types.py:115) - NOT a PLAY ability; the card is equipment and is never played. play._add_hero_dsl_activations scans the equipment slots including arms (play.py:259-265) and offers INSTANT at any priority window. Shape precedent: .drafts/compass_of_sunken_depths.json (same 'Instant - {t}:' sentence family on arms-slot equipment).

COSTS, not effects: both '{t}' and 'destroy this' sit before the colon, so both are ability-level cost entries paid before the effects run. TAP_SELF (cost_types.py:320-326) is payable only while untapped and taps; DESTROY_SELF cost (cost_types.py:43-51) destroys through canonical destroy(), which resolves the arms slot. can_pay of DESTROY_SELF is always true, so the pair is gated by the tap alone.

'{t} YOUR HERO' vs TAP_SELF: TAP_SELF taps the ACTIVATING CARD, which for equipment is this arms piece rather than the hero - a letter-level deviation from the printed wording. It is the corpus-wide spelling for equipment {t} (compass_of_sunken_depths), and no engine reader distinguishes hero.tapped for gameplay: arena_cards (state.py:962-967) includes the arms slot, so the end-phase untap (engine.py:880-882) refreshes it every turn and the tap is a once-per-turn gate either way. Flagged for review rather than silently chosen.

AMP reads amount (effect_types.py:1894-1899) and routes to effect_amp -> canonical amp(). Shipped AMP-in-JSON precedents: omn/arc_ramp_red.json ('Amp 3...'), ros/exploding_aether_blue.json, lgs/volzar_the_lightning_rod.json - the printed Amp text does not double-fire for DSL-defined cards.

activation_cost 0 at CARD level: the ability costs no {r}; {t} is a non-resource cost carried by the ability's cost array, and the explicit 0 stops the loader's printed-text heuristic from inventing one (assembly_module_blue precedent).
_note: Draft only - compiled and reviewed before adoption.
